constitutional_authority: applicable Nigerian law and competent public authority; Carbon Actual does not itself confer public authority
objective: Compose a reusable Suleja Local Government public-administration and revenue-governance system, beginning with IBB Market and transport, while preserving legitimate collector roles and creating auditable collection, reconciliation and service workflows.

initial_scope.jurisdiction: Suleja Local Government Area, Niger State, Nigeria
initial_scope.expansion_rule: Add additional revenue/service surfaces by configuration after the initial control cycle is verified.

core_workflows: authority/registry -> actor verification -> role/capacity assignment -> service/revenue operation
market registration -> unit/occupancy record -> assessment -> collection -> receipt -> daily reconciliation -> audit
transport registration -> route/operator/vehicle record -> assessment/collection -> receipt -> reconciliation
exception -> evidence -> case -> authorized review -> resolution -> audit trail
field observation -> inspection/evidence -> correction or escalation -> state update
control_principles: Collectors remain recognized operational roles; the system strengthens attribution, reconciliation and oversight rather than assuming abolition.
Discovery is not authority; official registries and competent authorities determine authoritative records.
A receipt is evidence of a recorded transaction, not by itself proof that the underlying obligation was lawful or complete.
Cash, bank money and e-money may be represented through the common economic fabric; settlement remains authority/provider gated.
Tokenization, minting, decentralization, decimalization and fractionalization remain available shared operations but are not prerequisites for LGA revenue collection.
Unknown or disputed records remain explicitly unresolved until evidence supports reconciliation.
promotion_gates: field connectivity and offline continuity tested
reuse_rule: After the Suleja control loop is verified, the same recipe is parameterized for additional LGAs and public-service/revenue domains without creating a separate governance ontology.
